title: Bank Of India Rupay Swadhan Platinum credit card

cardOverview.overviewText: Bank of India RuPay Star Lakshmi Credit Card is a women-focused lifestyle card offering Star Rewardz points on spends along with perks like OTT subscriptions and annual health check-up benefits.It’s a RuPay Platinum card suited for everyday usage, combining rewards, wellness, and entertainment benefits under a single, easy-to-use credit card.

items.title: Discover Reward Points Redemption Options
items.subtitle: To explore the full range of redemption options for this card, download the SaveSage Club app now.
